name: Griffith Vice Chancellor's International Scholarship
summary: 50% tuition fee scholarship for exceptional international students starting undergraduate or postgraduate coursework at Griffith in 2026 or 2027.
who: Citizen of a country other than Australia or New Zealand
Prior GPA of at least 6.0 on a 7-point scale
how: Once you have your Letter of Offer, apply by the closing date with academic records and a personal statement
catches: Trimester 1 2027 (Australian Year 12 completers): apply by 2 January 2027
Must keep a cumulative GPA of at least 5.5 and pass all courses

source.label: Griffith University: Vice Chancellor's International Scholarship

evidence.quote: Be a citizen of a country other than Australia or New Zealand.
